decisions.reason: As a simple, complementary cleaning product for the installed base, it supports the firm's full-system offer and recurring customer contact with little resource burden.
Maintenance oil remains closely tied to the core wood-floor business and provides attractive after-sales revenue with limited strategic risk.
This care line strengthens lifecycle support for oiled floors, though its partial overlap with other maintenance products keeps withdrawal risk slightly higher than for the clearest core complements.
A moisture-protection underlay is a practical installation accessory that fits trade demand well and reinforces the firm's system-selling approach.
High-density underlay foam complements the flooring range effectively and is worth retaining as part of a complete installation solution in a growing market.
